values.value: assumeNotNull((SELECT concat('Tuple(', arrayStringConcat(groupArray(type), ', '), ')') FROM (SELECT type FROM system.columns WHERE database = currentDatabase() AND table = 'fmt_native' AND name != 'ParsedParams.ValueDouble' ORDER BY position)))

test.fill_query: INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('formats_hits_read/hits.parquet', RawBLOB) SELECT * FROM url('https://clickhouse-public-datasets.s3.amazonaws.com/hits.parquet', RawBLOB) SETTINGS engine_file_truncate_on_insert = 1
INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('formats_hits_read/hits.orc', RawBLOB) SELECT * FROM url('https://clickhouse-public-datasets.s3.amazonaws.com/hits.orc', RawBLOB) SETTINGS engine_file_truncate_on_insert = 1

INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('formats_hits_read/hits.avro', RawBLOB) SELECT * FROM url('https://clickhouse-public-datasets.s3.amazonaws.com/hits.avro', RawBLOB) SETTINGS engine_file_truncate_on_insert = 1

INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('formats_hits_read/{zst}.zst', RawBLOB, 'raw_blob String', 'none') SELECT * FROM url('https://clickhouse-public-datasets.s3.amazonaws.com/hits.{zst}.zst', RawBLOB, 'raw_blob String', 'none') SETTINGS engine_file_truncate_on_insert = 1

SELECT throwIf(groupArray((_file, _size)) != [('arrow.zst', 1184001801), ('arrow_stream.zst', 1184213258), ('hits.avro', 1862157764), ('hits.orc', 3935355335), ('hits.parquet', 1316858464), ('native.zst', 898217804), ('rowbinary.zst', 989480943), ('tsv.zst', 1214829832)]) FROM (SELECT _file, _size FROM file('formats_hits_read/*', One) ORDER BY _file)

INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('formats_hits_read/hits.{zst}', RawBLOB) WITH (SELECT count() FROM file('formats_hits_read/{zst}.zst', LineAsString)) AS n SELECT if(rowNumberInAllBlocks() + 1 < n, line || '\n', line) FROM file('formats_hits_read/{zst}.zst', LineAsString) SETTINGS max_threads = 1, engine_file_truncate_on_insert = 1
INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('formats_hits_read/hits.tsv', LineAsString) SELECT * FROM file('formats_hits_read/tsv.zst', LineAsString) SETTINGS max_threads = 1, engine_file_truncate_on_insert = 1
INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('formats_hits_read/{zst}.zst', RawBLOB) SELECT '' SETTINGS engine_file_truncate_on_insert = 1
INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('formats_hits_read/tsv.zst', RawBLOB) SELECT '' SETTINGS engine_file_truncate_on_insert = 1

SELECT throwIf(groupArray((_file, _size)) != [('hits.arrow', 7103779634), ('hits.arrow_stream', 7103745632), ('hits.native', 6509566030), ('hits.rowbinary', 5761177036), ('hits.tsv', 7784351125)]) FROM (SELECT _file, _size FROM file('formats_hits_read/hits.{{arrow,arrow_stream,native,rowbinary,tsv}}', One) ORDER BY _file)
CREATE TABLE fmt_parquet ENGINE = File(Parquet, 'formats_hits_read/hits.parquet')
CREATE TABLE fmt_orc ENGINE = File(ORC, 'formats_hits_read/hits.orc')
CREATE TABLE fmt_avro ENGINE = File(Avro, 'formats_hits_read/hits.avro')
CREATE TABLE fmt_arrow ENGINE = File(Arrow, 'formats_hits_read/hits.arrow')
CREATE TABLE fmt_arrow_stream ENGINE = File(ArrowStream, 'formats_hits_read/hits.arrow_stream')
CREATE TABLE fmt_native ENGINE = File(Native, 'formats_hits_read/hits.native')
CREATE TABLE fmt_rowbinary AS fmt_native ENGINE = File(RowBinary, 'formats_hits_read/hits.rowbinary')
CREATE TABLE fmt_tsv AS fmt_native ENGINE = File(TSV, 'formats_hits_read/hits.tsv')

SELECT throwIf((SELECT (count(), sum(cityHash64(tuple(*)))) FROM (SELECT * FROM fmt_rowbinary LIMIT 2000000)) != (SELECT (count(), sum(cityHash64(tuple(* EXCEPT n)))) FROM (SELECT *, rowNumberInAllBlocks() AS n FROM fmt_rowbinary) WHERE n < 2000000)) SETTINGS max_threads = 1

SELECT throwIf((SELECT (count(), sum(cityHash64(tuple(*)))) FROM (SELECT * FROM fmt_avro LIMIT 1000000)) != (SELECT (count(), sum(cityHash64(tuple(* EXCEPT n)))) FROM (SELECT *, rowNumberInAllBlocks() AS n FROM fmt_avro) WHERE n < 1000000)) SETTINGS max_threads = 1
